verses.en: And it came to pass, that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul having passed through the upper coasts came to Ephesus: and finding certain disciples,
verses.sm: Keriso lea. O Je galuega a Paulo i Efeso, ma le Jaanunununu o le nuu e Temetiu Apolo i Korinito, ua tuanai ai e Paulo nuu maualuluga, ona oo lea i Efeso; ua na iloa ai isi soo,

verses.en: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.
verses.sm: ona fai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Na maua ea e outou le Agaga Paia ina ua outou faatuatua?” Ua fai mai i latou ia te ia, “E leai, matou tele'i faalogo lava pe i ai se Agaga Paia.”

verses.en: And he said unto them, Unto what then were ye baptized? And they said, Unto John's baptism.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o ia ia te i latou, “Pe na papatisoina outou i le a?” Ua fai mai i latou, “O le papatisoga a Ioane.”

verses.en: Then said Paul, John verily baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying unto the people, that they should believe on him which should come after him, that is, on Christ Jesus.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Paulo, “Na papatiso lava Ioane i le papatisoga o le salamo, ua fai atu i le nuu, ia faatuatua i latou i lē mulimuli mai, o lesu lea.”

verses.en: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai i latou, ona papatisoina lea i le suafa o le Alii o Jesu.

verses.en: And when Paul had laid his hands upon them, the Holy Ghost came on them; and they spake with tongues, and prophesied.
verses.sm: Ua faaee atu foi e Paulo ona lima ia te i latou, ona oo lea o le Agaga Paia ia te i latou; ona tautala lea i gagana, ma perofeta ane i latou.

verses.en: And all the men were about twelve.
verses.sm: O ia tagata uma, pe toatinoagafulu ma le toalua i latou.

verses.en: And he went into the synagogue, and spake boldly for the space of three months, disputing and persuading the things concerning the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ua ulufale foi o ia i le sunako, ma lauga faamalosi atu, ma tautalatala, ma faaoleole ia i latou i mea a le malo o le Atua i masina e tolu.

verses.en: But when divers were hardened, and believed not, but spake evil of that way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, disputing daily in the school of one Tyrannus.
verses.sm: A ua loto fatu nisi, ma ua le talitonu, o upu leaga mai i le Ala i luma o le toatele; ona alu ese lea o ia ia te i latou, ma ua vavae ese le au soo, ua tautalatala o ia i lea aso ma lea aso i le fale a‘oga o le tasi tagata e igoa ia Turano.

verses.en: And this continued by the space of two years; so that all they which dwelt in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.
verses.sm: Io E lua tausaga na faia lenei mea; o lea na faalogo ai i le afioga a le Alii o Iesu o i latou uma lava e ua nonofo i Asia, o Iutaia atoa ma Eleni.

verses.en: And God wrought special miracles by the hands of Paul:
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e le Atua vavega sili i lima o Paulo;

verses.en: So that from his body were brought unto the sick handkerchiefs or aprons, and the diseases departed from them, and the evil spirits went out of them.
verses.sm: o lea ua avea ai solosolo po o ie tali eleele nai lona tino i e mamai, ona mavae ai lea o latou rna‘i, ua 6 i fafo foi ia te i latou agaga leaga.

verses.en: Then certain of the vagabond Jews, exorcists, took upon them to call over them which had evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preacheth.
verses.sm: Ona faamalosi lea o isi o le au taulaitu Iutaia, o e na feoai, ua latou tau atu le suafa o le AW o Iesu i luga i e ua iai agaga leaga, ua faapea atu, “Matou te :matua fai atu ia te outou i le suafa o Iesu, o le ua tala‘iina e Paulo.”

verses.en: And there were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jew, and chief of the priests, which did so.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi lenei mea e nisi tagata o atalii e toafitu o Seva, o le Iutaia, o le ositaulaga sili.

verses.en: And the evil spirit answered and said, Jesus I know, and Paul I know; but who are ye?
verses.sm: A ua tali mai le agaga leaga, “Ua ou iloa Iesu, ua ou iloa foi Paulo, :1 0 ai ea outou na?”

verses.en: And the man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overcame them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
verses.sm: Ona oso mai ai lea o le tagata ua i ai le agaga leaga, ua manumalo ia i latou, ua faiaina lava i latou ia te ia; ona sosola ai lea o i latou i fafo o le fale ua le lavalava ma ua manunua.

verses.en: And this was known to all the Jews and Greeks also dwelling at Ephesus; and fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
verses.sm: Ua iloa lenei mea e i latou uma lava e ua nonofo i Efeso, o Iv.taia atoa ma Eleni; ona oo lea o le mataʻu ia te i latou uma lava, ua viia foi le suafa o le Alii o Iesu.

verses.en: And many that believed came, and confessed, and shewed their deeds.
verses.sm: Ua o mai foi i latou e toatele o e ua faatuatua, ma faaali mai ma ta'u mai a latou amio.

verses.en: Many of them also which used curious arts brought their books together, and burned them before all men: and they counted the price of them, and found it fifty thousand pieces of silver.
verses.sm: E toatele foi o e na fai togafiti faataulaitu, na faapotopoto e i latou a latou tusi, ma susunu ai i luma o tagata uma; ona latou faitau lea i a latou faatusa, ua iloa ai ua lima sefulu o afe o tupe ario.

verses.en: So mightily grew the word of God and prevailed.
verses.sm: O lea ua matuá tupu tele ai ma ua manumalo le afioga a le Alii.

verses.en: After these things were ended, Paul purposed in the spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go to Jerusalem, saying, After I have been there, I must also see Rome.
verses.sm: Ua mavae ia mea, ona tuu lea e Paulo i lona loto, a uma ona ui ane i Maketonia ma Akaia, e alu i Ierusalema, ua faapea o ia, “A mavae ona ou i ai, e tatau ona ou asiasi i Roma.”

verses.en: So he sent into Macedonia two of them that ministered unto him, Timotheus and Erastus; but he himself stayed in Asia for a season.
verses.sm: Ona aauina atu lea e ia Maketonia tagata e toalua o e na auauna ia te ia, o Timoteo ma Erato, a o ia ua fai po ona nofo i Asia.

verses.en: And the same time there arose no small stir about that way.
verses.sm: O ona po ia ua tupu ai le faanunununu tele ona o le Ala.

verses.en: For a certain man named Demetrius, a silversmith, which made silver shrines for Diana, brought no small gain unto the craftsmen;
verses.sm: Aua o le tasi tagata, o Temetiu le igoa, o lé fai mea ario, le na fai malumalu ario o Tiana, ma ua maua ai le oloa tele mo tufuga;

verses.en: Whom he called together with the workmen of like occupation, and said, Sirs, ye know that by this craft we have our wealth.
verses.sm: ua faapotopoto e ia ia te i latou, atoa ma le au faigaluega i mea faapena, ua fai atu, “Soma e, ua outou iloa o lenei faiva ua tatou tamaoaiga ai;

verses.en: Moreover ye see and hear, that not alone at Ephesus, but almost throughout all Asia, this Paul hath persuaded and turned away much people, saying that they be no gods, which are made with hands:
verses.sm: ua outou iloa foi ma outou faalogo, e le gata i Efeso, a ua táli soo Asia uma lava, ona faaliliueseina ai e lena Paulo le vao tagata E toatele i lona ole, ua faapea atu, e le ni atua e ua faia e lima.

verses.en: So that not only this our craft is in danger to be set at nought; but also that the temple of the great goddess Diana should be despised, and her magnificence should be destroyed, whom all Asia and the world worshippeth.
verses.sm: E le gata ona máumau o lo tatou nei faiva, o le a tuulafoaiina, a e peitai e ta‘uleaogaina foi le malumalu o le atua fafine silisili o Tiana, o le a faaumatia foi lona mamalu, o loo tapuai i ai Asia uma lava atoa ma le lalolagi uma.”

verses.en: And when they heard these sayings, they were full of wrath, and cried out, saying, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo i latou,onatutumu ai lea o i latou i le felili, ua alalaga atu, “E silisili Tiana o Efeso.”

verses.en: And the whole city was filled with confusion: and having caught Gaius and Aristarchus, men of Macedonia, Paul's companions in travel, they rushed with one accord into the theatre.
verses.sm: Ua matua lolofi mai le aai atoa, ua pupue atu foi ia Kaio ma Aritako, tagata Maketonia, o tagata o le malaga a Paulo, ona feosofi lea o i latou ma le loto gatasi i le fale mataaga.

verses.en: And when Paul would have entered in unto the people, the disciples suffered him not.
verses.sm: Ua fia ulufale atu Paulo i le nuu, a ua le mafafai le au 500.

verses.en: And certain of the chief of Asia, which were his friends, sent unto him, desiring him that he would not adventure himself into the theatre.
verses.sm: O isi alii foi o Asia o ena alolofa ia te ia, na latou aan atu nisi la te ia e ole atu, aua le faamalosi ona alu i le fale mataaga.

verses.en: Some therefore cried one thing, and some another: for the assembly was confused; and the more part knew not wherefore they were come together.
verses.sm: Ua alalaga nisi i le tasi mea, ma nisi i le tasi mea; aua ua soona vevesi le faapotopotoga; ua le iloa foi e le toatele le mea na potopoto ai i latou.

verses.en: And they drew Alexander out of the multitude, the Jews putting him forward. And Alexander beckoned with the hand, and would have made his defence unto the people.
verses.sm: Ua faatu atu foi e nisi o i latou ia Alesana nai le motu o tagata, ina ua tuuina atu o ia e Tutaia. Ona talo atu lea o Alesana lona lima, ua na fia faatonu atu i le nuu.

verses.en: But when they knew that he was a Jew, all with one voice about the space of two hours cried out, Great is Diana of the Ephesians.
verses.sm: Ua iloa e i latou o le Iutaia o la, ona tasi ai lea o latou leo uma lava, pe lua itula ua alalaga ai i latou, “Ua silisili Tiana o Efeso.”

verses.en: And when the townclerk had appeased the people, he said, Ye men of Ephesus, what man is there that knoweth not how that the city of the Ephesians is a worshipper of the great goddess Diana, and of the image which fell down from Jupiter?
verses.sm: Ua faafifilemuina le motu o tagata e le tusiupu, Ona fai atu lea o ia, “Sema e, o outou Efeso e, o ai lea tagata ele iloa o loo auauna lenei aai o Efeso i le malumalu o le atua fafine silisili o Tiana, ma le tupua na pau ifo mai le lagi?

verses.en: Seeing then that these things cannot be spoken against, ye ought to be quiet, and to do nothing rashly.
verses.sm: O lenei, ona ua le mafai ona faafitia o nei mea, e tusa ona outou fifilemu, ma ia aua le soona fai se mea.

verses.en: For ye have brought hither these men, which are neither robbers of churches, nor yet blasphemers of your goddess.
verses.sm: Aua ua ta‘ita‘i mai e outou nei tagata, e le ni e fao i mea sa, pe upu leaga i latou i lo outou atua fafine.

verses.en: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.
verses.sm: O lenei, afai ua ia Temetiu ma lana au tufuga se mau i se tasi, ua tuu aso e fai ai faamasinoga, O i ai foi suikonesula; ia momoli ai le tasi i le tasi.

verses.en: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.
verses.sm: Peitai ane, afai tou te sue i nisi mea, e faatonuina lea i le fono e tala‘iina.

verses.en: For we are in danger to be called in question for this day's uproar, there being no cause whereby we may give an account of this concourse.
verses.sm: Ana neʻi molia i tatou ona o le taalili vale i lenei aso, ina ua leai lava sa tatou upu e mafai ona tatou faatonu atu ai lenei nunu vale.”

verses.en: And when he had thus spoken, he dismissed the assembly.
verses.sm: Ua uma atu ia upu, ona faatuña lea e ia o le faapotopotoga.
